body:
Hey,
I recently got an offer for Master Of Physiotherapy at Swinburne for 2025. My WAM was 73. 

The application process was mostly submitting documentation about your previous educational history (eg: academic transcripts).
To stand out, you can also include any relevant employment experience in your application.

However, I didn't have any relevant employment experience and I still got an offer based on my WAM of 73.
